subject.title: [Bug]: Write/exec tool parameters silently dropped after long conversations (content/command missing)

question: After the Tool Search subset in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/96115 is resolved, should this issue remain the broad tracker for long-session provider/session argument loss or be split/closed?
rationale: Current source proof covers compact Tool Search forwarding, while this issue and recent comments also describe mid-session argument loss with nested args, provider streaming, and session pressure that the open PR does not prove fixed.

options.title: Keep broad tracker open
options.body: Keep this issue open until a live long-session provider/session reproduction is fixed or confidently ruled out after the Tool Search subset lands.

options.title: Split remaining scope
options.body: After the Tool Search PR lands, designate a narrower follow-up for provider/streaming long-session argument loss and close this issue with that canonical link.

options.title: Close after Tool Search fix
options.body: Close this issue after the Tool Search subset lands only if maintainers intentionally define the remaining reports as covered or not actionable.

recommendation.title: Keep broad tracker open
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a live long-session provider/session reproduction is fixed or confidently ruled out after the Tool Search subset lands.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter is the strongest current-history owner signal for the Tool Search parser and local-model lean surface where source proof exists.
